title: PM-JANMAN Rural Road DPRs
client: PMGSY Division No. I, Agartala / TRRDA
summary: Detailed Project Report preparation for rural road projects, including bridges and cross-drainage structures, under PM-JANMAN in Tripura.
scope: Preparation of rural road Detailed Project Reports.
Coverage of associated bridges and cross-drainage structures.
Documentation in accordance with the PMGSY guidelines specified in the appointment.
note: Notice to proceed and letter of acceptance dated 11 January 2024.

title: Chapra River Bridge
summary: DPR consultancy for the bridge over the Chapra River on the T01 road connecting the Alipurduar–Falakata road via Mathura Bazar.
scope: Reconnaissance survey using DGPS and LiDAR.
Sub-soil investigation and detailed survey.
Hydrology survey and preliminary project report.
Engineering design and Detailed Project Report preparation.
note: Appointment letter, bridge schedule and consultancy certificate.

title: Gharghoria River Bridge
client: Executive Engineer, WBSRDA, Cooch Behar-II Division
summary: DPR preparation for the bridge over the Gharghoria River at Hatidoba, on the PMGSY road from Bhetalguri–Cooch Behar–Alipurduar Pucca Road at Kalimandir Road.
scope: Reconnaissance survey using DGPS and LiDAR.
Sub-soil investigation and detailed survey.
Hydrology survey and preliminary project report.
Engineering design and Detailed Project Report preparation.
note: Appointment letter, bridge details and consultancy certificate.

title: Karatia River Bridge
client: Sundarban Development Board, Civil Engineering Division No. IV
summary: DPR preparation for a proposed bridge and approaches over the Karatia River at Hedia, under Atharobanki Gram Panchayat, Canning-II.
scope: Topographical, hydrographical and traffic surveys.
Detailed soil reporting for pile-depth determination.
River discharge calculations and hydrological data.
Structural design, reinforcement details and general arrangement drawings.
Estimates for the bridge and approaches, with the specified vetting.

title: 57 Rural Roads & Culverts
summary: Engagement by NABCONS for preparation of DPRs for 57 rural roads and culverts in connection with inclusion under RIDF-XXIX.
scope: Field studies, soil testing and topographical surveys.
Traffic census, road condition and bridge / cross-drainage inventories.
Road plans, profiles, cross-sections and pavement design.
Culvert design, structural drawings and detailed estimates.
Report preparation and technical vetting specified through Jadavpur University.
note: NABCONS work order dated 11 April 2023; engagement as project-based contract staff.

title: New SSK Building
summary: Building DPR preparation for the new SSK at Panchpara under Sankrail Block in Howrah District.
scope: Soil investigation and site survey.
Foundation design.
Building drawings.
Detailed estimate and Building DPR preparation.
note: Letter of acceptance cum work order dated 15 July 2024.

title: Goureswar River Bridge
summary: DPR preparation for the proposed bridge over the Goureswar River at Bishpur under Hingalganj Block in North 24 Parganas.
scope: Preparation of the Detailed Project Report for the proposed river bridge.
DPR assignment under the WBSRDA Basirhat Division work order.
